lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: The champagne tasted like ash long before the glass emptied. I remain because the alternative requires walking past my father's expectations in the entrance hall.
lines.expression: fingers whitening around the flute stem, chin lifted, eyes fixed on a distant torch

lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: Your father isn't here tonight. The professors have retreated to the staff table, and the corridors belong to whoever dares keep walking.
lines.expression: shoulders relaxed, head tilted slightly, gaze steady on her face
